name: Pull-request Action
responsibility: Posts one comment on a pull request with its proposal, the architecture before and after as SVG, and the modules whose code changed inside and outside the plan
description: A composite GitHub Action. It finds the proposal from its state input, the archboard-pr marker in the description, or the only draft. It renders the base and the head, commits the SVGs to the orphan branch archboard-assets so that GitHub shows them, and updates one sticky comment on each push. The footprint compares the head with the base branch. With out-of-plan set to fail, a module changed outside the plan fails the job unless the override label is on the pull request.

outgoing.label: installs the CLI and runs render and footprint
